title: spfx-foundry-deploy config
description: All fields are optional. The deployer infers slug from your package.json 'name' and defaults profile to 'chat-completions'. Drop a deploy.config.json next to your webpart only if you want to commit non-default values or pre-declare serveProperties to be prompted for at deploy time.

slug.description: Stable identifier — keys .deploy-output.json so multiple webparts in one repo can coexist. Defaults to your package.json 'name' field (with @scope/ stripped). Lowercase, alphanumeric + dashes.

profile.description: Provisioning recipe. 'chat-completions' (default) provisions one model deployment behind the proxy and writes the singular AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT app setting. 'multi-model' provisions N deployments from 'models[]' and writes role-named AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_<ROLE> / AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION_<ROLE> settings; the single-model path is unaffected.

namePrefix.description: Drives Azure resource names (rg-<prefix>, <prefix>-ai, <prefix>-proxy, etc.). User can edit at deploy time. Defaults to slug if omitted.

location.description: Default Azure region. User can change at deploy time. Defaults to swedencentral.

model.description: chat-completions profile only — default single model. The deploy form lets the user pick a different one from those available in the chosen region.

name.description: Model family name, e.g. 'gpt-5-mini', 'gpt-4o-mini'. Defaults to gpt-5-mini if available.

models.description: multi-model profile only — the deployments to create on the AOAI/Foundry account. No interactive picker; declared explicitly. Each gets a role-named app setting (AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_<ROLE>, uppercased $role) plus AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION_<ROLE> when apiVersion is set. The single shared AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT is also written; backends derive any provider-specific endpoint from it.

deploymentName.description: Explicit deployment name created on the account.

version.description: Model version. Omit to let Azure pick the default.

format.description: Model format passed to az (e.g. 'OpenAI', 'Microsoft'). Defaults to 'OpenAI'.

apiVersion.description: Per-role API version, written as AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION_<ROLE>.

$role.description: Role tag the backend uses to pick this deployment, e.g. 'image', 'analyze', 'router', 'embeddings'. Uppercased into the app-setting suffix.

sharepointOrigin.description: Origin used in App Service CORS + ALLOWED_ORIGIN. Must match the SharePoint tenant origin hosting the SPFx component. If omitted, the deployer suggests/prompts one.

backendPath.description: Path to the Azure Functions backend, relative to this config file. Defaults to '<webpartDir>/backend'. Set it when the SPFx solution and the Function backend live in separate folders (e.g. config in spfx/, backend at ../backend).

requestLimits.description: Per-caller request rate limits enforced by the proxy.

serveProperties.description: Extra properties to merge into the patched serve.json (e.g. 'environmentId' for MCP webparts). Empty-string values mean 'ask me at deploy time' — the deployer prompts for them and writes the answer into serve.json only, leaving the file's empty-string contract intact for next deploy.

defaults.description: DEPRECATED. Earlier configs used this block to override individual resource names; new configs should use namePrefix instead. Still honoured for backwards compat — explicit values here win over namePrefix-derived ones.
